The plan rescues all six people for a total cost of 154 minutes, with no one deferred. The three injured people at Suryagadhi market are the priority, and the farmer and elderly couple at Gosaikunda temple are collected on a second run. I did not use the Dhunche farm to Gosaikunda road because of the fast floodwater.

<plan>
drive car1 myagang-shelter suryagadhi-market
load car1 injured 3
drive car1 suryagadhi-market myagang-shelter
unload car1 injured 3
drive car1 myagang-shelter gosaikunda-temple
load car1 elderly 2
load car1 adult 1
drive car1 gosaikunda-temple myagang-shelter
unload car1 elderly 2
unload car1 adult 1
</plan>
